payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort intervals by start; greedily keep a single bomb point updated to the minimum end among overlapping intervals; once an interval starts after the point, place a new bomb.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts intervals (default by start) then uses a greedy pass to determine bomb placements. The core idea is to order intervals and make greedy decisions—classic greedy_sorting_order pattern. No custom key or exchange argument is explicit.
